subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce exact owner equality for all parent session use

question: After the parent authorization race is fixed, should plugin-runtime operations fail closed on every legacy ownerless session row?
rationale: Exact equality is the strongest rule and matches sessions.delete, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for persisted rows created without plugin ownership.

options.title: Fail closed consistently
options.body: Treat ownerless rows as having no plugin authority across session operations and document and prove the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Migrate attributable rows
options.body: Use doctor to assign owners only where reliable provenance exists, then keep runtime authorization exact.

options.title: Allow ownerless adoption
options.body: Preserve plugin access to ownerless rows, accepting ambiguous ownership and a weaker isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Fail closed consistently
recommendation.body: Treat ownerless rows as having no plugin authority across session operations and document and prove the upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current session lifecycle service implementation and is the best available owner for its security and upgrade contract.
